metrics.notes: Exact algebraic or categorical invariant; no measurement uncertainty is implied.

source.title: NASA Glenn ascent drag equation
source.derivation: For this fixed-motor, fixed-mass vertical case, increasing positive drag from Cd=0.5 to 0.8 must reduce apogee. Comparator returns 1 only for two finite positive results with strictly lower transformed apogee.

model.description: The browser JavaScript production estimator. Each case records the exact model and assumptions identity that it exercises.

comparison.decisionRule: Report the stated invariant or analytic difference; acceptance requires a separate independent review.

notes: Bounded synthetic case; does not generalize to all transonic shapes or real vehicles. Review-only; no flight validation or acceptance is claimed.
